verdict.rationale: Steel's own integration docs describe tools that "extract, return typed results" (AI SDK), "typed Python agents" (Pydantic AI), and "extract structured data" (Pi). However, the schema typing and validation come from those third-party agent frameworks, while Steel's native browser tools only convert pages to markdown, readability text, screenshots or PDFs. missing for 10: a native Steel schema-based extraction API (Zod/Pydantic schema in, validated JSON out), documented validation and error behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract typed, schema-validated data (Zod/Pydantic-style) from pages the agent visits, not just raw text

citations.quote: The Steel integration runs each tool against a Steel cloud session (open, navigate, snapshot, extract, return typed results)
provider-agnostic, typed Python agents with dependency injection and real web access
so Pi can navigate, scrape rendered pages, extract structured data, capture screenshots and PDFs
